zh: 用公共电脑的时候，记得用完要登出。
en: Remember to {log out|log off|sign out} when you use a public computer.

zh: 电影看到一半我就迷迷糊糊睡着了。
en: I {drifted off|dozed off|nodded off|fell asleep} halfway through the movie.

zh: 这个新应用在青少年中很快流行起来了。
en: The new app has really {caught on|taken off} with teenagers.

zh: 电影看到一半我就打起瞌睡来了。
en: I {nodded off|dozed off|fell asleep|drifted off} halfway through the movie.

zh: 那个视频一天后就被删掉了。
en: The video was {taken down|removed|deleted} after a day.

zh: 记者最喜欢翻出名人以前发的帖子。
en: Journalists love {digging up|finding|unearthing|dragging up} celebrities' old posts.

zh: 注册只需要一分钟。
en: It only takes a minute to {sign up|register|join}.

zh: 我们换个台吧？这个节目好无聊。
en: Can we {switch over|change over|switch|turn over}? This show is boring.

zh: 别剧透结局！
en: Don't {give away|spoil|reveal|tell} the ending!

zh: 几百万人收看了决赛。
en: Millions of people {tuned in|watched} to see the final.

zh: 我硬着头皮看完了一部三个小时的电影。
en: I {sat through|got through|suffered through|endured} a three-hour movie last night.

zh: 删掉旧照片可以腾出一些手机空间。
en: Deleting old photos will {free up|clear|clear up} some space on your phone.

zh: 把地图放大，就能看到街道名称。
en: {Zoom in} on the map to see the street names.

zh: 这块污渍在照片上几乎看不出来。
en: The stain barely {shows up|shows} in the photos.

zh: 我离不开我的手机。
en: I couldn't {do without|live without|manage without|survive without} my phone.

zh: 我发照片之前稍微修了一下。
en: I {touched up|edited|retouched} the photos before posting them.

zh: 苹果上个月推出了一款新手机。
en: Apple {brought out|released|launched|put out} a new phone last month.

zh: 你能把那段视频回放一下吗？
en: Can you {play back|replay} that bit of the video?

zh: 这部电影没有大家吹的那么好。
en: The movie didn't {live up to} the hype.

zh: 她的新书下周出版。
en: Her new book {comes out|is released|is published} next week.

zh: 我翻看了手机里所有的老照片。
en: I {looked through|went through|scrolled through} all the old photos on my phone.
